The '''Belsavis system''' was located in the [[Ninth Quadrant]], which was part of the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
